newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans and soymeal fall near expanded limit.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans and soymeal fall near expanded limit.

text.p: CBOT soybean and soymeal futures fell near their expanded limits in late dealings amid fast trading, and contract lows were set, traders said.
Local selling added to the declines posted earlier with spillover from Monday's bearish USDA acreage report cited.
Liquidation of the July/November spread also was a feature in late dealings, they said.
At 1314 CDT, soybeans were 26 to 43 cents per bushel lower, with July down 43 at $7.28. Soymeal was $4.00 to $14.00 per ton lower, with July down $14.00 at $244.00.
